description: Known, justified exceptions to tools/check-architecture.mjs. Every entry needs a reason; entries that no longer match a violation fail the check. See docs/ENFORCEMENT.md. Format: recoveredRuntime and crossFeature entries are { "from": "assets/src/app/...", "to": "assets/src/...", "reason": "..." }; cycles entries are { "files": [ "assets/src/app/...", ... ], "reason": "..." }; rawColours entries are { "file": "assets/src/app/...", "value": "#rrggbb", "reason": "..." }; rawSpacing entries are { "file": "assets/src/app/....css", "value": "999px", "reason": "..." }; sharedHooks entries are { "file": "assets/src/app/features/...", "hook": "usePagedList", "reason": "..." }.

rawColours.reason: Example value in the translated help text of the learner branding colour fields; it is shown as text, not used as a colour.

Contrast helper: it returns plain black or white as the readable text colour for a chosen brand colour, and falls back to black when the stored colour is invalid. These are computed data values, not styling.

rawSpacing.reason: Enrollment-source chips are pills. 999px stays fully round on every radius preset; --oml-radius-button is 2px on the WordPress preset, and there is no separate pill token.

legacyRouteUrls.reason: return_url() resolves ohmylms_return and assessment profiles' return_route, which are legacy route names by design; it keeps LegacyRoutes::url() until those inputs store app paths.
